_note: Gym scale: every method returns exactly 50,000 samples per problem instance (the paper used 10,000), and the hidden test runs each sampler on held-out observations, so Table 2 numbers are not on this scale. They are kept unchanged under '_paper_*' keys. Non-underscore results are this gym's own measurements on the hidden test (sgdd = reference, K=10, T=10, H=20 as in Appendix C.3). Gradient-free sampling is an eligibility rule (scoring/CONSTRAINTS.md), not a self-reported metric.

synthetic_d2.description: Table 2 synthetic posterior recovery, D=2, coordinatewise observation |x_d - c| with sigma=3.

hellinger.description: Hellinger distance between the empirical and exact posterior marginal of the first two coordinates (Table 2 metric).

total_variation.description: Total variation distance on the same first-two-coordinate posterior marginal (Table 2 metric).

all_pairs_hellinger.description: Mean Hellinger distance over every coordinate pair: the whole joint posterior, not only the reported pair, must be sampled.
